Investors are optimistic about Indian firms capturing substantial market share, with some analysts predicting further gains contingent on capacity expansion and sustained earnings growth.

stories.title: India's Godrej Consumer expects volume-driven first-quarter revenue rise
stories.summary: Godrej Consumer anticipates a robust first quarter, projecting high-teen consolidated revenue growth driven by solid underlying volume increases. Key international markets, including Indonesia and the GUAM region, demonstrated strong performance, contributing to the positive outlook and suggesting the company is on track to surpass its full-year targets.

stories.title: Dabur Q1 updates: Co expects double-digit revenue growth as rural demand stays ahead of urban

This frustration can lead to costly mistakes like chasing rallies or abandoning sound investments. Fred C. stories.title: India bonds rise for sixth straight week as foreign flows continue
stories.summary: Indian government bonds took a small step back on Friday, halting a strong six-week upward trend. The market's prior gains were supported by vigorous foreign investor interest, spurred by the prospect of being included in a global debt index and easing crude oil prices. Billions have flooded into Indian bonds recently, particularly the key 10-year note, as overseas investors expect substantial passive investment influxes.

stories.title: Scientists discover giant fan-shaped structure beneath Antarctica's ice sheet
stories.summary: Scientists have unearthed a colossal, fan-shaped geological formation hidden beneath East Antarctica's ice. This massive structure, dubbed the East Antarctic Fan-Shaped Basin Province, connects previously known underground basins, reshaping our understanding of ancient supercontinent Gondwana's breakup and Antarctica's ice sheet behavior amid climate change. The discovery reveals a more dynamic geological past for East Antarctica than previously believed.
